evals.prompt: Simulate a one-meter cape with 40 frames of settle and deliver a reusable cinematic cache.
evals.expected_output: An editable, scoped result with discipline-specific settings, actual evidence and stated unverified gates.
assertions: Distinguishes sequential memory evaluation from durable bake.
Sets simulation and shot ranges, pinning, collider clearance and modifier order.
Reopens cache in a fresh process and reports engine representation limits.

evals.expected_output: A diagnosis tied to the supplied failure, preserved sources, a concrete correction and repeated affected acceptance checks.
assertions: Distinguishes sequential memory evaluation from durable bake.
Sets simulation and shot ranges, pinning, collider clearance and modifier order.
Reopens cache in a fresh process and reports engine representation limits.
